output.title: Your text-back scripts
output.text:
INSTANT MISSED CALL TEXT (fires within 60 seconds)

Hello, this is Cedar Repair. We are sorry we missed your call. Please reply with your name and what you need, and we will respond shortly.

You can also grab a time here: https://example.com/request - Alex


AFTER HOURS VERSION

Thanks for reaching out to Cedar Repair. We are closed right now (we are open Monday-Friday, 9 a.m.-5 p.m.), but we got your message and you are first up in the morning. Reply here with what you need so we can hit the ground running.

You can also grab a time here: https://example.com/request - Alex


FOLLOW UP, DAY 2

Hey, Alex again. Just circling back on your call the other day. Still want me to take a look at it? Yes or no is fine, I would just rather not leave you hanging.


FOLLOW UP, DAY 5

Last one from me, I promise. If the timing is not right, no problem at all, keep my number. If you still need it handled, reply HERE and I will get you on the schedule.


SETUP NOTES
- Fire the instant text within 60 seconds. Speed is the entire point.
- Send from the same number people called, not a different one.
- Somebody has to actually watch the replies.
- Include your opt-out language if you are sending automated marketing texts.

verdict.text: The instant text is the one that matters. Two minutes late and they already called somebody else.

result.note: Automated texting is regulated. Reply STOP handling, clear identification and consent rules apply to marketing messages. A direct reply to someone who just called you is a different thing than a blast, but know your rules.

output.title: Your review request scripts
output.text:
REVIEW REQUEST TEXT (review before sending)

Hi, this is Alex with Cedar Repair. Thank you for trusting us with the chair repair. If you would like to share your experience, you can leave an honest review here:
https://example.com/review

Your feedback is welcome either way. Thank you.


EMAIL VERSION

Subject: Your experience with Cedar Repair

Hi there,

Alex here from Cedar Repair. Thanks again for trusting us with the chair repair.

If you would like to share your experience, you can leave an honest Google review at the link below.

https://example.com/review

Your feedback is welcome regardless of your rating. You can also reply with a service question; getting support does not depend on leaving or changing a review.

Thanks,
Alex
Cedar Repair


IN PERSON SCRIPT

"Thank you for your business. If you would like to share your experience, you are welcome to leave an honest review. Would you like the review link? There is no obligation."

Provide the link through an appropriate channel if the customer wants it. Do not pressure them to review while on the premises.


OPTIONAL REMINDER (only if appropriate and no decline or opt-out)

Hi, Alex with Cedar Repair again. Here is the review link in case you wanted to share your experience. No need to reply, and thank you again for your business.
https://example.com/review


REVIEW CHECKLIST
- Use a consistent milestone after a genuine customer experience, regardless of expected rating.
- Verify that the link opens the correct business listing.
- Never offer incentives or condition the request on satisfaction.
- Do not require a private survey before showing the public review link.
- Check communication permission and stop after a decline, opt-out, or completed response.
- This tool drafts language; it does not send messages or create reviews.

verdict.text: Review the wording, verify the listing link, and invite honest feedback without trying to influence the rating.

output.title: Your voicemail scripts
output.text:
MAIN GREETING

"Thanks for calling Cedar Repair, this is Alex. We are either on a job or on another call right now. Leave your name, your number, and what you need, and we will call you back first thing the next business day. If you would rather text, send a message to (202) 555-0142 and we will get right back to you. You can also book online at example.com/request. Thanks."


AFTER HOURS

"You have reached Cedar Repair. We are closed right now, but we check messages every morning. Leave your name, number, and what is going on, and you will be one of the first calls we make. If you would rather text, send a message to (202) 555-0142 and we will get right back to you. If this is an emergency, [say what they should do]. Thanks for calling."


ON A JOB / BUSY DAY

"Cedar Repair, Alex here. We are running jobs today so we are slow to the phone. Leave a message and we will call back first thing the next business day. If you would rather text, send a message to (202) 555-0142 and we will get right back to you. Appreciate you."


RECORDING TIPS
- Stand up. You sound more awake.
- Say the phone number and any website slowly, twice.
- Keep it under 20 seconds. People hang up on long greetings.
- Re-record it when your hours or schedule change. An outdated greeting reads as a closed business.

verdict.text: Better than a perfect voicemail: an automatic text to everybody who hits it. Voicemail is the backup, not the plan.
